name: badminton
description: A badminton shuttlecock with a feather skirt and rounded cork base.
misuse: Pair this symbol with a clear label when its meaning depends on context.

16.reason: Shallow feather tips and two converging dividers keep the skirt distinct from a funnel. The cork base remains round and open.

24.reason: The feather crown stays shallow above three open skirt panels. A slight upward adjustment centers the rounded cork and skirt in the drawing frame.
